hierarchy.h1: font-display text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-[1.1] text-foreground
hierarchy.h2: font-display text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.overline: font-sans tracking-[0.2em] text-xs font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground

rules: Strict contrast: Text on accent (#5FD3A6) MUST be foreground (#1A2E25).
Strict contrast: Text on background and cards MUST be foreground (#1A2E25) or muted-foreground (#4A6054).
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for text; use #F9F8F6 instead.

components.Button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses bg-[#1A2E25]. Accent (high-priority CTA) uses bg-[#5FD3A6]. Add hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-all.
components.Card: Use bg-[#F1EFE9] with rounded-2xl and 1px border of #E8E6DF. Do not over-shadow; rely on border and subtle bg contrast.
components.Input: bg-[#F9F8F6] border-[#E8E6DF] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#5FD3A6] focus:border-transparent outline-none.
components.Header: MUST NOT be fully transparent. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 with border-b border-[#E8E6DF].
components.Badge: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold bg-[#E8E6DF] text-[#1A2E25].

layouts.spacing: Use 2x-3x more whitespace than default. Use py-20 to py-32 for section padding to ensure a premium, uncrowded feel.
layouts.grids: Use Bento grids for features. Asymmetrical layouts for marketing pages. Strict tabular/dense layouts for Dashboards.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle opacity and slight Y-axis transform on mount.
motion.hover_states: Buttons translate-y-[-2px]. Cards should have subtle shadow enhancement without moving.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Muted text must be #4A6054 on #F9F8F6.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must use the Mint accent (#5FD3A6) with 2px offset.
accessibility.data_testids: CRITICAL: Do NOT break functionality or rename existing data-testids. Add them to new interactive elements.

page_specific_instructions.Home: Hero must feature a large, immersive image (rounded-3xl) with the car search widget overlapping it at the bottom. Use Cabinet Grotesk for the massive headline. Ensure the search widget uses glassmorphism.
page_specific_instructions.Search_Results: Grid of vehicle cards. Each card must have a high-quality 4:3 image, price (bold Cabinet Grotesk), and specs presented cleanly with Lucide/Phosphor icons.
page_specific_instructions.Vehicle_Detail: Two-column desktop layout. Immersive photo gallery on the left/top. Sticky cost breakdown panel on the right. Clear 'Apply' CTA using the Mint accent.
page_specific_instructions.Registration_Wizards: Distraction-free layout. Remove primary navigation. Show a clear progress bar using #5FD3A6. Generous spacing around form inputs.
page_specific_instructions.Dashboards: High-density functional UI. Use #F9F8F6 base with #FFFFFF or #F1EFE9 cards. Avoid rounded-3xl here, stick to rounded-xl. Sharp typography hierarchy.

instructions_to_main_agent: The project uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all components as React .jsx/.js.
The user's primary concerns are text legibility, alignment, and lack of a premium feel. Fix this by strictly enforcing the typography hierarchy and color contrast rules defined here.

Maintain the specific color hexes requested (Dark Forest Green #1A2E25, Warm Off-White #F9F8F6, Mint Accent #5FD3A6) but apply them carefully. The mint is for high-priority actions; the green is for text and primary elements; the off-white is for backgrounds.
Do NOT center-align everything. Use left-aligned text for paragraphs and forms to improve readability. Optical alignment is key.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for any element that sits over scrolling content (like headers). Use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent color.
All interactive elements MUST preserve existing data-testids. New elements must include kebab-case data-testids.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
